items.summary: Co-RL: unsupervised reasoning in language/vision models via multi-agent RL without ground-truth supervision. Research on reasoning training.

items.snippet: Continuous self-improvement requires an ever-expanding pool of self-generated, diverse, adaptive goals. For language agents, existing training environment pools (hand-curated, statically synthesized, or frozen-verifier) keep the goal distribution fixed as the learner scales. items.summary: SPADE: self-play framework for language agents with adaptive goal synthesis. Training method for continuous agent improvement.

items.snippet: Vision encoders are a critical component of vision-language models, and scaling their capacity effectively improves performance. However, dense scaling increases compute cost and inference latency. items.summary: MoE-ViE: mixture-of-experts vision encoder for efficient multimodal scaling. Architecture for efficient vision-language models.

items.title: FM-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Management with Competing Agents
items.snippet: Language model agents now execute bounded tasks reliably. Whether they can sustain effective decision-making over long horizons, where actions have cumulative consequences and the environment responds to their choices, remains largely unmeasured. items.summary: FM-Bench: long-horizon agent benchmark with competing agents and cumulative consequences. Evaluation framework for complex agentic tasks.

items.summary: PTXBench is a benchmark for evaluating and adapting LLMs to generate architecture-specific PTX code for GPU kernel optimization, measuring correctness and speedup.

items.summary: SemComp-Bench: benchmark for semantic task completion in video generation. Evaluation framework for outcome-oriented generation.

items.summary: Decision-metric alignment in latent world models for MPC planning. Research on world model training for agent control.

items.summary: SoftVTBench: visuo-tactile dataset for deformable-object manipulation. Multimodal dataset for robot learning.

items.summary: Capability-centric data design for generalist image generation. Framework for heterogeneous multi-task dataset curation.

items.summary: SkillForge: self-distilling agents for project-specific issue resolution. Method for agents to acquire repository-specific knowledge.

items.summary: FACET proposes a method for synthesizing high-quality terminal tasks with consistent instruction, environment, solution, and verifier artifacts for training terminal agents.

items.summary: AdaPop: adaptive unlearning for popular facts in LLMs. Method addressing differential memorization in model weight-space unlearning.
